profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is an autonomous driving technology company that describes itself as pursuing a vision of autonomous mobility worldwide. Founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley, it says it develops autonomous driving technology and has accumulated millions of kilometers of autonomous road testing in complex scenarios. Its core technology is called a "virtual driver," and it organizes its business into three units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). The company states that its vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024, and that it holds licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous vehicles in multiple locations.

The company is publicly traded under the ticker PONY, with a CIK of 0001969302, and is headquartered in Guangzhou. It is a for-profit public company.

No litigation, patent records, or other products appear in the material available here beyond the three business units the company describes.
